sources.snippet: TaxBERT This repository accompanies the paper: Hechtner, F., Schmidt, L., Seebeck, A., & Weiß, M. (2025). How to design and employ specialized large language models for accounting and tax research: The example of TaxBERT. TaxBERT is a domain-adapated RoBERTa model, specifically designed to analyze qualitative corporate tax disclosures.
